name: Karma Atranger
original_name: カーマ・アトランジャー
source:
Karma Atranger is a girl protected by the Revolutionary Group, Ice Flame, being the leader of the kids gang in the orphanage ran by Kimchi Drive. Being one of the eldest among the children, she tried to act like an older sister to the other kids. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Karma_Atranger]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
